evidence.root_cause: The global proportional Gemma4 RoPE cross-mixes full head halves with identity-padded angles; the program incorrectly applied the 0.25 factor twice and treated the active dimensions as a contiguous prefix. Candidate FP8 K stores also skipped the stock path's post-RoPE BF16 rounding.

causal_change: Construct get_rope exactly like installed Gemma4Attention: head_dim as rotary_dim plus partial_rotary_factor.
Consume Gemma4RotaryEmbedding.rotary_dim and its identity-padded full-head cache, preserving cross-half mixing.
Round post-RoPE output to BF16 before the candidate FP8 cache store, matching the stock two-stage rounding boundary.
Persist Q/K/V boundary relative-L2 fields to localize any remaining mismatch.
